scenario.task:
I call to check my bill, but when I hear about a massive charge I didn't make, I want to report fraud immediately

User Guide: Ask to check your bill. Authenticate. When the assistant mentions a high balance, say 'Wait, I didn't make those charges, someone must have hacked my account!' Accept the immediate transfer If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
